subject: Invoice sender + delivery preference for recurring invoices
messages:
From: Sofia Berglund <sofia.berglund@novus-retail.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@novus-retail.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 14:12:00 +0000
Subject: Setting up invoice delivery and sender for Novus (PO 87234)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — excited to get started. Our AP team needs to confirm one item before we enable the weekly bill run: who will be the invoice sender ("Bill From") for Redwood invoices, and whether we should expect PDFs via email or pull them from your portal.

Specifics from our side:
- PO: 87234 (please reference on invoices)
- AP contact: accounts-payable@novus-retail.com (we'll attach a vCard for the team)
- Tax/VAT: Novus is VAT-registered in Sweden; we need VAT number on the invoice and documentation in case reverse-charge applies.

Can you let us know: 1) which legal entity will appear on the invoices (company name + VAT ID), 2) whether Redwood can push PDFs to our AP mailbox, or if you prefer portal-only delivery with email copies enabled? If portal, please confirm we can still receive a copy to accounts-payable@novus-retail.com for our archive.

Also looping in AP for verification.

Thanks,
Sofia Berglund
Procurement Lead, Novus Retail
sofia.berglund@novus-retail.com
attachment: novus_ap_contact.vcf (vCard)

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: accounts-payable@novus-retail.com, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Setting up invoice delivery and sender for Novus (PO 87234)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear note. Short answers up front:
1) The invoices will be issued by "Redwood Inference, Inc." (US legal entity) unless you require a local EU entity. We can include our EU VAT registration number on the invoice footer — I'll confirm the exact VAT ID in the next message (cc Kim to validate the tax evidence).
2) We prefer to use the Redwood Billing Portal for recurring invoices (centralized, downloadable XML/PDF and automated archive), but we can push a PDF copy to accounts-payable@novus-retail.com on invoice delivery.

A couple of asks so we can finalize setup:
- Can AP confirm whether they require an invoice PDF only, or an accompanying XML/UBL payload as well?
- Does the PO number need to be in a specific invoice field (reference, line notes, or header)?

Connor from Billing is looped in to provide the draft invoice and the portal onboarding link.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

- Invoice Sender: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- VAT: will include our EU VAT ID and a line showing net amount + VAT as applicable. If Novus intends to reverse-charge, we'll include the "reverse charge" note and your VAT number in the header.
- Delivery: default = Billing Portal (preferred for monthly/recurring). We'll enable an automatic PDF copy to accounts-payable@novus-retail.com for the first 3 months while your AP confirms archival process.
- Metadata: PO "87234" will go in the Invoice Reference field (top-right). If AP needs it elsewhere, say where.

Attachment: invoice_2026-12-31-draft.pdf (PDF, 88KB) — this is a preview only, numbers are illustrative.

If portal is OK, next steps to enable: 
1) I will send an invite to your AP mailbox to create a portal account (one-time step).
2) We will schedule a quick 15-min handoff to verify VAT formatting and that the PO appears in your ERP as expected.

Kimberly — can you confirm the exact EU VAT ID we should print?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
